title: Cyclic source pairings for Penrose--Sparling non-Hausdorff twistor spaces
summary: We introduce noncommutative geometry techniques in order to reinterpret the Penrose--Sparling non-Hausdorff twistor space of the anti-self-dual Coulomb field by means of an explicit etale gluing groupoid and its convolution algebra. This algebraic model keeps track of both the identified open part and the two non-separated copies of the source quadric. We compute two kinds of Chern--Connes pairings.
